Alien Isolation 2 - Official Developer Interview
Don't miss this behind the scenes developer interview for Creative Assembly and SEGA's highly anticipated follow up to Alien Isolation. Ana Sopikova and Laura Mauterer, Art Director and Principal UI Artist respectively, go over questions regarding to the development of Alien Isolation 2. 
Alien Isolation 2 is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
The Definitive Proof That GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption Share The Same Universe
There are dozens of Easter eggs in GTA 6, but Rockstar has also slipped in more than a few nods to some of the studio’s previous games within Leonida. There’s a Manhunt-themed tattoo, for example, and a ludicrously convoluted secret already unearthed involving a portal back to the days of Vice City. But one series is showing up more than others: Red Dead Redemption.
We’re still working our way through finding all of them, as is the rest of the internet, but so far we’ve found seven secrets that relate to the developer’s beloved Western games. From hats and guns to road names and license plates, here are the best Red Dead Easter eggs in GTA 6.

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Official Decimation Update Trailer
Check out the latest update for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, the action shooter from Focus Entertainment. The Decimation Update brings all new customization options, a new PVP mode and a rework for the Vanguard class! 
Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam), and Xbox Series X|S.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Hitman World of Assassination - Official Bawma's Elusive Targets Trailer (ft. Lenny Kravitz)
Bawma from 007 First Light has contracted Agent 47 to eliminate traitorous members of his crew in this brand new update for Hitman World of Assassination, the stealth action game from IO Interactive! Lenny Kravitz returns to provide his likeness and voice to the Bond villain, and you can take on his contract November 26th - December 24th, 2026!

text:
Tuesday Morning - Official Release Date Trailer
Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Tuesday Morning, an action-adventure game developed by Fear Ahead Studios. Players will fight in a single area to combat enemies across a stylized, minimalistic landscape. Explore new mechanics and battle through the trials and errors of Tuesday Morning, launching on December 4 for PlayStation 5 (PS5).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
The Witcher 3 Wild Hunt Remastered - Official Cross-Platform Mod Support Trailer
Check out the trailer for the latest update for The Witcher 3 Remastered from CD Projekt Red. Cross-Platform Mod Support is coming to The Witcher 3 Wild Hunt with this latest free update, featuring a myriad of curated player mods, given official support by CD Projekt Red. Give Geralt all new hairstyles, glowing eyes and the Hearts of Stone brand, with all new gameplay quests available for download from inside the game. 
The Witcher 3 Remastered is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam, GoG) and Xbox Series X|S.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Infinity Nikki - Official 3.0 Launch Trailer
Don't miss this extensive look at Infinity Nikki's 3.0 launch trailer, Ingold Games open-world fashion adventure game! With a staggering amount of content, you'll be able to enjoy new sights and sounds across two new cities, new outfits that grant special abilities, new weapon classes, new vehicles, new characters and much more! 

Infinity Nikki 3.0 launches November 26th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam), iOS and Android.
